plugins.name: personal-skills
plugins.description: Shared personal skills for Claude Desktop, Cowork, and Claude Code.

plugins.name: complexity-lens
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: complexity, density and hotspot score above the prompt for files Claude reads or edits. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: one-line prompt-cache meter above the prompt with a countdown to cache expiry. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: nested-agents-md
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: loads nested AGENTS.md for files Claude touches through Bash, Edit or Write; the built-in agents-md mod loads them only on Read. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: issue-hygiene-reminder
plugins.description: Claude Code and Codex hook: before a GitHub issue write (gh issue create/edit/close/comment, gh api on issues, GitHub MCP issue writes), adds a one-paragraph reminder of the issue-hygiene rules. Never blocks.
